findings.text: the done-when orders that the scripts "are found by resolving every package name and attribute each script uses against the tree, not by importing alone", which prescribes a discovery procedure in plan text and anchors the sweep to a static resolution that both over- and under-reports: attributes provided dynamically (`__file__`, a module `__getattr__`, names bound by `getattr`/`importlib` inside the script) resolve as missing when the script runs, and attributes that resolve statically can still fail at run time; the observable the section actually wants is a committed script that no longer runs as committed, plus the missing name it reports, and that is directly checkable (the three sn-review-through-jev scripts reach `DEFAULT_NAME_RECEIPTS`/`DEFAULT_DOCS_RECEIPTS` on `cascade_calibration`, both absent, and `srtj-jev-name-evidence-measure-run.py` and `name-definition-check-run.py` fail at import)
